headerDisplay: *Please note this plugin requires an active SimpliSafe 'interactive' monitoring plan.* This plugin only adds SimpliSafe cameras, and runs alongside homebridge-simplisafe3 (for the alarm, sensors and locks) with its own SimpliSafe login. Enable it as a child bridge (Bridge Settings), pair that bridge in the Home app, and turn off cameras in homebridge-simplisafe3.

batterySnapshotMinutes.title: Battery Camera Snapshot Interval (minutes)
batterySnapshotMinutes.description: How old a battery camera's snapshot can get before viewing it in the Home app wakes the camera for a new one. Lower values use more battery. Plugged-in cameras refresh every minute.

record.title: Record in HomeKit (HomeKit Secure Video)
record.description: Names of the cameras HomeKit may record, as shown in the SimpliSafe app. Then choose 'Stream & Allow Recording' for each in the Home app. Needs a home hub and iCloud+.

alwaysConnected.title: Always Connected (plugged-in cameras only)
alwaysConnected.description: Of the recording cameras, those to keep streaming all the time, so a recording starts with the seconds before the motion. SimpliSafe reports motion 4-8 seconds late, so without this a recording starts after the motion began. Uses about 2 Mbps per Outdoor Camera, all the time. Remove a camera to stop.

eventImages.title: Use SimpliSafe's Event Images for Notifications
eventImages.description: For Outdoor Cameras, a motion or doorbell notification shows SimpliSafe's own image of the event when it is ready within 3 seconds (usually under 1), instead of waking the camera for a new one.

motionTest.title: Motion Test (temporary)
motionTest.description: For a test session only: after each motion or doorbell event, measure how soon the camera's video arrives and how soon SimpliSafe's own clip of the event can be read, and write the results to the log. Each event wakes a battery camera (at most once a minute per camera). Turn on Debug as well, and turn this off again afterwards.

enableHwaccelRpi.title: Enable Hardware Acceleration for Raspberry Pi
enableHwaccelRpi.description: This may not work if you set the path to use a custom build of ffmpeg

items.description: Show extra messages about plugin behavior.
Find your account number under SS web control panel > View Account. See README for more info.
Keep this plugin's recent log lines, without passwords, tokens or account numbers, for the 'Logs for Claude' card on this page. Nothing is sent anywhere.

By default, the plugin won't remove cameras from the Home app that SimpliSafe no longer lists. This is to avoid caching issues causing you to lose all your scenes & automations configurations. If you do want to remove old cameras, set this to false.

items.title: Excluded Cameras
items.description: Cameras to leave out of HomeKit, by the serial number shown in the SimpliSafe app.
